mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandin synthesis, reducing glomerular filtration rate and increasing serum potassium, while eplerenone is a potassium-sparing aldosterone antagonist that further increases potassium retention.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative analgesia or reduce NSAID duration; ensure adequate hydration and renal function baseline before initiating combination therapy.
